contracts_rationale: The only interface is a GitHub Actions workflow_call contract, specified in data-model.md and pinned by tests/ci/test_docs_site_job.py; there is no API or schema to publish.
purpose_context: The docs-site CI job and the Pages deploy must share one build definition so main can never deploy a site no pull request built. This mission extracts the build into a reusable workflow the router job calls now and the cutover (#6938) will call from the deploy; DocFX keeps deploying unchanged.
purpose_tldr: One reusable workflow builds the doc-kitty site for the CI gate and the future deploy (#6937, ADR 2026-10-31-1 D-11)
